'''Saumitra Das''' (born 20 January 1962) is an Indian microbiologist and a professor at the Department of Microbiology and Cell Biology of the [[Indian Institute of Science]]. Known for his studies in the fields of [[molecular virology]] and [[molecular biology]], Das is an elected fellow of all the three major Indian science academies namely, the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] and the [[Indian National Science Academy]]. The [[Department of Biotechnology]] of the Government of India awarded him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to biosciences in 2005.<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development">{{Cite web |url=http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf |title=Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development |date=2016 |publisher=Department of Biotechnology |access-date=2017-11-20 |archive-date=4 March 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304191331/http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Biography ==
[[File:Nikhilmore IISc Bangalore india.jpg|thumb|left|IISc Bangalore]]
Saumitra Das, born on 20 January 1962<ref name="Fellow profile-S Das">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Das,_Prof._Saumitra |title=Fellow profile-S Das |date=2017-12-19 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-12-19}}</ref> in the Indian state of [[West Bengal]], did his doctoral studies on the [[host-pathogen interaction]] of [[Leishmania donovani]], an intracellular parasite which causes [[leishmaniasis]], at the [[Indian Institute of Chemical Biology]] which earned him a PhD from the [[University of Calcutta]] in 1992.<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das">{{Cite web |url=http://mcbl.iisc.ac.in/Saumitra/principal-investiogator.html |title=Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das |date=2017-12-19 |website=mcbl.iisc.ac.in |access-date=2017-12-19 |archive-date=18 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200218014822/http://mcbl.iisc.ac.in/Saumitra/principal-investiogator.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> He continued his research on host-virus interactions during his post-doctoral days at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] (UCLA) and after completion of the work, he joined the university in 1994 as an assistant research virologist. On his return to India in 1998, he joined the [[Indian Institute of Science]] (IISc) where he later became an associate professor<ref name="Saumitra Das - Division of Biological Sciences, Indian Institute of Science">{{Cite web |url=http://bio.iisc.ac.in/?q=faculty/saumitra-das |title=Saumitra Das - Division of Biological Sciences, Indian Institute of Science |date=2017-12-19 |website=bio.iisc.ac.in |access-date=2017-12-19 |archive-date=22 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222052254/http://bio.iisc.ac.in/?q=faculty%2Fsaumitra-das |url-status=dead }}</ref> and serves as a professor at the Department of Microbiology and Cell Biology.<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das -  research intro">{{Cite web |url=http://mcbl.iisc.ac.in/Saumitra/ |title=Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das - research intro |date=2017-12-19 |website=mcbl.iisc.ac.in |access-date=2017-12-19 |archive-date=22 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222051219/http://mcbl.iisc.ac.in/Saumitra/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> He also coordinates the functioning of the ''Centre of Excellence for Research on Hepatitis C virus'', a research arm of the [[Department of Biotechnology]] housed in IISc campus.<ref name="Centres of excellence – Salient Achievements">{{Cite web |url=http://www.dbtindia.nic.in/salient-achievements/ |title=Centres of excellence – Salient Achievements |date=2017-12-19 |website=www.dbtindia.nic.in |access-date=2017-12-19}}</ref>

Das resides in the New Housing Colony of the Indian Institute of Science in [[Bengaluru]], [[Karnataka]].<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=D |title=NASI fellows |date=2017-12-19 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=2017-12-19 |archive-date=17 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150717020647/http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=D |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Legacy ==
[[File:HCV.png|thumb|Hepatitis C virus - [[electron micrograph]].]]
The microbiological research of Saumitra Das covered the fields of [[molecular virology]] and [[molecular biology]].<ref name="Indian fellow - S Das">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P12-1571 |title=Indian fellow - S Das |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> During his post-doctoral days at UCLA, Das identified ''I-RNA'', a small [[RNA]] molecule isolated from the yeast species of [[Saccharomyces cerevisiae]] and demonstrated its antiviral activity against viruses that cause [[polio]] and [[hepatitis C]].<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das" /> Later, at IISc, he focused on the translation of [[Hepatitis C Virus]] (HCV) and has done [[in vivo]] and [[in vitro]] experiments on the characterization of ''La'', a cellular [[trans-acting]] factor.<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das - translation">{{Cite web |url=http://mcbl.iisc.ac.in/Saumitra/Hepatitis-C-virus.html |title=Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das - translation |date=2017-12-19 |website=mcbl.iisc.ac.in |access-date=2017-12-19}}</ref> The team of scientists led by Das concentrates on the regulation of [[Transcriptional regulation|transcription]] and [[Translation (biology)|translation]], especially hepatitis C virus and [[Coxsackie B virus|Coxsackievirus B3 RNA]].<ref name="BurmaChakravorty2011">{{cite book|author1=D. P. Burma|author2=Maharani Chakravorty|title=From Physiology and Chemistry to Biochemistry|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4CaQ3-x3LXMC&pg=PA430|year=2011|publisher=Pearson Education India|isbn=978-81-317-3220-5|pages=430–}}</ref> The research conducted by Das, along with Anjali Anoop Karande (his colleague from the biochemistry department of IISc) and their teams were successful in the development of a vaccine for hepatitis C; the vaccine, a mixture of [[virus-like particle]]s, worked by enveloping the HCV proteins.<ref name="A novel vaccine against Hepatitis C Virus customized for the Indian population">{{Cite web |url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/vaccine/news/a-novel-vaccine-against-hepatitis-c-virus-customized-for-the |title=A novel vaccine against Hepatitis C Virus customized for the Indian population |date=2017 |website=Elsevier |access-date=2017-12-19}}</ref> His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles<ref name="On Google Scholar">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=L04YAt0AAAAJ&hl=en |title=On Google Scholar |date=2017-11-23 |publisher=Google Scholar |access-date=2017-11-23}}</ref><ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Das=3ASaumitra=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2017-12-17 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-12-17}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[ResearchGate]], an online repository of scientific articles has listed 111 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Saumitra_Das2 |title=On ResearchGate |date=2017-12-17 |access-date=2017-12-17}}</ref> He and his colleagues hold several patents for the processes they have developed.<ref name="Saumitra Das Inventions, Patents and Patent Applications - Justia Patents Search">{{Cite web |url=https://patents.justia.com/inventor/saumitra-das |title=Saumitra Das Inventions, Patents and Patent Applications - Justia Patents Search |date=2017-12-20 |website=patents.justia.com |language=en |access-date=2017-12-20}}</ref> He is also a member of the [[American Society of Virology]] and the [[American Society for Microbiology]].<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das" />

== Awards and honors ==
The [[Department of Biotechnology]] of the Government of India awarded him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]], one of the highest Indian science awards in 2005.<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development"/> The [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] elected him as a fellow in 2009,<ref name="Fellowship - Indian Academy of Sciences">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/listing/fellows/D |title=Fellowship - Indian Academy of Sciences |date=2017-12-17 |website=www.ias.ac.in |language=en |access-date=2017-12-17}}</ref> the same year as received the elected fellowship of [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] (NASI).<ref name="NASI Year Book 2015">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |title=NASI Year Book 2015 |date=2017-12-17 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=2017-12-17 |archive-date=6 August 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150806211716/http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> The NASI honored him again a year later with the 2010 [[National Academy of Sciences, India|NASI]]-[[Reliance Industries|Raliance]] Platinum Jubilee Award.<ref name="NASI-[[Reliance Industries|Raliance]] Platinum Jubilee Award">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/ripja.htm |title=NASI-Raliance Platinum Jubilee Award |date=2017-12-20 |website=www.nasi.org.in |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-date=2 February 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202234730/http://www.nasi.org.in/ripja.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> The [[Ranbaxy Laboratories|Ranbaxy Science Foundation]] chose him for the Ranbaxy Research Award for medical research in 2012<ref name="Ranbaxy Declares Research Awards 2012 “honours Five Outstanding Scientists & Five Young Science Scholars”">{{Cite web |url=http://www.evaluategroup.com/Universal/View.aspx?type=Story&id=499016 |title=Ranbaxy Declares Research Awards 2012 "honours Five Outstanding Scientists & Five Young Science Scholars" |date=22 March 2014 |website=www.evaluategroup.com |access-date=2017-12-20}}</ref> and he received the elected fellowship of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] the same year.<ref name="INSA Year Book 2016">{{Cite web |url=http://www.insaindia.res.in/pdf/YearBook_2016.pdf |title=INSA Year Book 2016 |date=2017-12-17 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2017-12-17}}</ref> He was selected for the J. C. Bose National Fellowship of the [[Science and Engineering Research Board]] of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]] in 2014.<ref name="Laboratory of Dr. Saumitra Das" />
